description: Per-block tanglement score: counts forward references emitted by this block's uses[] to later chapters, and forward references received from earlier chapters. High scores indicate the block is misplaced or tightly coupled to content in a different chapter.

metrics.fwd_emitted: Forward refs this block emits (uses[] targets in later chapters)
metrics.fwd_received: Forward refs this block receives (blocks in earlier chapters that uses[] this block)
metrics.worst_pair: The chapter pair with the most forward refs involving this block
